verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a billing platform, since self-hostable billing systems exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows Stripe Billing can be deployed on user infrastructure. Every capability described is a Stripe-run service accessed through the Dashboard or API, and the public OpenAPI spec and isolated sandboxes are integration aids, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
